info.name: Shagung E-commerce - Admin API
info.description:
Admin API endpoints for Shagung E-commerce Platform.

Base URL: {{baseUrl}}

## Authentication
All admin endpoints require Bearer token with admin role.
Login as admin user to get token.

## Variables
- baseUrl: http://localhost:5000
- adminToken: Admin JWT token
